scoring_justification: Recomputing formation energies from total energies requires hidden reference total energies which cannot be reliably obtained without the paper's raw DFT data; thus result-level comparison with tolerance is used. Phonon stability is verified by threshold on minimum frequency (no raw dispersion recomputation).

outputs.description: Agent-computed total energies and formation energies per formula unit for the five ternary compounds.

units.dynamically_stable: boolean (true if no imaginary modes, allowing for small numerical noise)

outputs.description: Dynamical stability verdict and minimum phonon frequency for each ternary compound.

output_contract.notes: The formation energies are recomputed by the checker from the agent's total energies using hidden reference total energies and compared to the paper's reported formation energies with a tolerance. Phonon stability is checked by verifying that minimum_frequency_cm-1 > -5 cm⁻¹ and dynamically_stable is true for all compounds.

hidden_assets.purpose: Formation energy targets from paper Table S2 and main text
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table S2 (FeF2He: -0.53, FeF3He: -0.56, FeF2Xe: -0.10, FeF3Xe: -0.54, FeCl3Xe: -0.01 eV/f.u.)
hidden_assets.generation_method: exact values reported in the paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values taken directly from the paper's reported formation energies.
